The petitioners are before this Court calling in question investigation/proceedings in Crime No.137/2022, pending before the III Additional Chief Metropolitan Magistrate, Bengaluru,
registered for the offences punishable under Sections 406, 420 and 506 r/w. 34 of the IPC.
Learned counsel for the parties in unison submit that during the pendency of this petition, the parties to the lis have entered into a settlement by drawing up certain terms and conditions.
opennyai_summary.decision:
A copy of the compromise petition under Section 320(2) r/w. Section 482 of the Cr.P.C. is filed to that effect before this Court, which recognizes the closure of the impugned proceedings.
It is also submitted that the terms and conditions of the settlement will be adhered by the parties.
3. The compromise petition insofar as it concerns the subject lis, reads as follows:
"4.
Tenant under the Petitioners namely Naveen K.S. has filed a civil suit before the learned City Civil Judge Bangalore, CCH-18 IN O.S.No.2022/2023 against the respondent no.2 herein.
2 5 . It is submitted that, after the interference of the elders, well wishers of both the parties the Petitioners & Respondent have settled their differences under the terms and conditions below mentioned.
6. It is agreed that, the Petitioners shall repay a sum of Rs.22,00.000/- (Rupees Twenty Two Lakhs Only) to the second respondent, which both the parties have agreed.
The second respondent has agreed to NC: 2023:KHC:21550 withdraw from the agreement for Conformation of Lease Deed dated 04/02/2021."
In terms of the afore-extracted compromise petition entered into between the parties, I deem it appropriate to terminate the proceedings initiated against the petitioners for the afore-quoted offences, which are the ones punishable under Sections 406, 420 and 506 r/w. 34 of the IPC, as the same are not against the State.
4. For the aforesaid reasons, I pass the following:
ORDER (i) The criminal petition is disposed.
(ii) The investigation / proceedings in Crime No.137/2022, pending on the file of the III Additional Chief Metropolitan Magistrate, Bengaluru, stand quashed, qua the petitioners.
Pending I.A.'s, if any, is disposed, as a consequence.
